A. LP (vinyl record)
B. Cassette tape
C. CD
D. DVD

questions.text:
39.  In a CD player, there is light
I.  from reflections from lands on the CD
II.  from reflections from pits on the CD
III.  direct from the laser.
What light is involved in the interference that allows information to be recovered from a CD?
A.  II only
B.  I and II only
C.  I and III only
D.  II and III only

40.  Analogue audio signals are sampled and digitally stored on a device that can hold 4.8 Mbits of
information.  The sampling rate is 40 kbits per second.  What is the maximum duration of the
audio signal that can be stored?
A.  120 ms
B.  833 ms
C.  120 s
D.  833 s
